question:
Study the given pie charts and answers the question that follows.

The pie charts represent the values of sales and expenses of five companies A, B, C, D, E in terms of percentages.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48832975c69b7136368c2e336b4e83104fd2c72fc8db3f2ea92496e9671580f9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000a382eeba6a286910adc689efa4acda9ebd4e003162df4390e7d58aee2383c.png] 

Based on the visual reading of the pie-chart, which of the companies has the highest percentage loss?
solution:
**Calculation:**

E has more expenses but it has no share in the sales. 

**∴ E has more % loss.**
